aggregate_computation.normalization_formula: score = 100 * (1 - mean_lookups / LOOKUP_CAP), LOOKUP_CAP = 6 (max plausible distinct external-lookup categories per site per the frozen list: callee signature, variable declaration, type declaration, overload set, trait/interface implementation, imported definition, global configuration/mode), clamped to [0,100].

caveats: This is a single-language (TypeScript-only) computation performed in isolation from the other nine language shards; the runner must recompute the common-basis figure (probes where ALL TEN languages have a fragment) once all shards are merged, per capability_universe.json interaction_with_quality_metrics.common_basis_rule.

Lookup counts were estimated per-probe (not exhaustively per individual semantic_site_matrix.json site_id row) because no other language's fragment/support data was available in this packet to establish the common basis; a full site-level recount is recommended once fragments are authored and published per pre_measurement_validation V1.

No actual TypeScript source fragments were compiled/run under the frozen recipe in this packet-only worker (no toolchain access); support levels and lookup counts are documented judgments consistent with TypeScript/Node/ECMAScript standard documentation and are marked as such rather than fabricated build evidence.
metric.semantic_locality.method: For each of the 44 frozen probes, determined TypeScript support level (FULL/PARTIAL/NONE) under the frozen recipe (tsc --strict --target es2022 --module nodenext), then estimated the minimum non-local lookup count required to resolve the probe's semantic facts from the fragment's local surface form alone. Only lookups required (not optional/for-detail) were counted, per the frozen locality rule. Probes scored NONE for TypeScript (no fragment exists) are excluded from the aggregate, consistent with the common-basis / all-fragments distinction in capability_universe.json (interaction_with_quality_metrics). This worker computed the all-fragments TypeScript figure since cross-language common-basis membership requires results from the other nine language workers, which are out of this packet's scope; the runner is expected to recompute the common-basis figure once all language shards are merged.
metric.semantic_locality.metric_definition_source: semantic_compression.md section 6.1.3.C: number of required external semantic lookups or declaration-graph hops needed to resolve a fact in the fixed inventory; lower is better.

none_probes_excluded.reason: N-1: TypeScript/JavaScript has no documented mechanism for two same-scope names to denote one writable primitive scalar storage location (no reference/pointer/inout for primitives).
N-1: no documented way for a callee to write a caller's scalar primitive local; wrapping in a mutable object is explicitly disallowed as a FULL/PARTIAL substitute per rubric P-a note.
N-2: no built-in FFI mechanism in TypeScript/Node under the frozen recipe; ffi-napi and similar are third-party packages, disqualified by R7.
N-2/N-1: no built-in mechanism to export a stable unmangled C-ABI symbol from compiled TypeScript/Node output under the frozen recipe.
